result.stdout:
Description:
  Convert files to Markdown — powered by ElBruno.MarkItDotNet

Usage:
  markitdown-dotnet <file> [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <file>  File to convert to Markdown

Options:
  -o, --output <output>  Write output to file instead of stdout
  --format <format>      Output format: markdown or json [default: markdown]
  --streaming            Use streaming API for supported formats
  -q, --quiet            Suppress status messages on stderr
  -v, --verbose          Show metadata (word count, timing, format)
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --version              Show version information

Commands:
  batch <directory>  Batch-convert all files in a directory
  url <url>          Convert a web page URL to Markdown
  formats            List all supported file formats and their converters

result.stdout:
Description:
  Batch-convert all files in a directory

Usage:
  markitdown-dotnet <file> batch <directory> [options]

Arguments:
  <file>       File to convert to Markdown
  <directory>  Directory containing files to convert

Options:
  -o, --output <output> (REQUIRED)  Output directory for converted files
  -r, --recursive                   Process subdirectories recursively
  --pattern <pattern>               File glob pattern (e.g. *.pdf)
  --parallel <parallel>             Max parallel conversions [default: 4]
  --format <format>                 Output format: markdown or json [default: markdown]
  -q, --quiet                       Suppress status messages on stderr
  -?, -h, --help                    Show help and usage information
